newsitem.title: CANADA: Inco funds native study of Voisey's Bay.
newsitem.headline: Inco funds native study of Voisey's Bay.

text.p: Inco Ltd's Voisey's Bay Nickel Co said on Thursday it has agreed to fund a social and economic study of the Innu Nation, a native group that uses the land around the planned Voisey's Bay nickel, copper and cobalt mine.
The study will compile information about demographics, socio-economics and traditional knowledge of land use, Voisey's Bay Nickel said in a statement.
The study will take place over the next six months by several teams of aboriginal researchers.
Since much of the traditional ecological knowledge has never been written down, the researchers will use videos to record data, the company said.
The Innu and the Labrador Inuit both have outstanding land claims in the area around Voisey's Bay.
Both groups are currently negotiating with government officials for their land claims, as well as negotiating with Voisey's Bay Nickel for impact and benefits agreements linked to the mine.
